notes.shadows: None: the addon draws no shadow (Elevation & Depth).
notes.motion: No motion tokens. The one timed change is the alert banner, shown 6 s then faded over 1 s (AlertBanner.lua).
notes.breakpoints: Not responsive breakpoints: the window widths Layout is checked at (M.TERMINAL_VIEWPORTS: compact 760x540, auction 792x482, large 1024x700, hd 1056x702, ultrawide 1778x936) plus the preview's 1440x900.
notes.tonalRamp: Synthesized in OKLCH at the token's hue and chroma, lightness 15% to 95%; the code defines no tonal scale.
notes.components: Stand-in values for the one look (ADR 0085) from tools/terminal-dev/static/style.css; client art (the dialog border, tab and button templates) is stood in by flat fills.

narrative.northStar: A page of the classic client
narrative.overview: Market's window is the profession window's own frame: its stone and metal border over the rock, a centred gold title in the band, two dark insets, the recipe list's header bars, red buttons, bottom tabs, and white words for what Market saw beside grey words, with their reason, for what it did not. Beside the Tailoring frame (the live reference, R13) it reads as the same craftsman's work; Market's identity is the Ink Rule, not a costume. One look (`MATERIALS.dark`); views pass token and kind names, never colours. Density is a two-page spread per view at 13 px body type. Everything is drawn with client widgets, client fonts and guarded client art; no art file or font ships.
keyCharacteristics: The profession window's frame (R15): its metal border and title band, close button and bottom tabs; two insets with a gap. The dark dialog is the fallback.
White for what Market saw, grey with its reason for what it did not, † for AHledger; red only for losses.
Client fonts only: Friz Quadrata headings and labels, Arial Narrow figures and cells.
Classic controls: `UIPanelButtonTemplate` actions, `PanelTabButtonTemplate` tabs, the classic dark dropdown list, the classic scroll bar, the size grabber.
No shadows, no gradients, no radius; depth is the client's own art.
Hover lies beneath the words; every control answers clicks across at least 24 units (gamepad cursor).

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: White is what Market saw; grey is what it did not, with its reason (ADR 0047 LM4, LM12; R13). The text model and the chart display list name each value's ink; no painter guesses. Every ink reads at least 4.5:1 on `ground`, `panel`, `raised` and `hover` (flat and added at 0.7), pencil at least 3:1 on the ground; the chart's carries and the "Last seen" rule read 3:1 after their alpha (part `materials-contrast`). A pencil figure always has a reason word beside it. Red is only for a loss.

rules.name: The One-Table Rule
rules.body: Every colour, face and piece of client art comes from the one entry in `U.STYLE.materials` (ADR 0085). A source test fails on any colour outside it; the token check refuses a second look.

rules.name: The Classic-Up Rule
rules.body: Start from the classic client and build up; never take from retail and build down (Shane's doctrine, 2026-10-11). A new control is a classic control with a facelift.

rules.name: The One-Register Rule
rules.body: The window and the world are one register (R13). The world frames wear the tooltip-border family (`U.classicBackdrop`: the client's tooltip border and background on the `menu` fill at 0.92, Market's `menu` panel where `BackdropTemplate` is missing): the Scan bar, the alert banner (`GameFontNormal` over `GameFontHighlight`), the guide tracker, and the bag value tab and its panel. The dropdown list and GameTooltip are dark; popups use the client's frame templates.

rules.name: The Client-Faces Rule
rules.body: Only the client's fonts. A face the client lacks falls back to Friz Quadrata (`SetFont` returns false); the preview's stand-ins are layout evidence only.

rules.name: The Plain-Glyph Rule
rules.body: Player text is ASCII plus `·`, `—`, `–`, `×` and the footnote dagger `†`; a cut reads "..." (ADR 0037 phase A, ADR 0047 LM13).

rules.name: The No-Fake-Depth Rule
rules.body: Client bevels or nothing. The preview's box-shadows (the Details slip, the tooltip stand-in, the coin discs) are not in the addon and are not part of the system.

dos: **Do** take every colour, face and art key from `U.STYLE.materials`, and add a token to both looks.
**Do** name each value's ink in the text model or display list; pencil for carried, estimated, unknown or old.
**Do** say why an unknown is unknown in plain words: "?" for a day with no record, "open your bank to count", "not bought on AH — no cost" (LM15, LM24).
**Do** use the client's templates and art: `UIPanelButtonTemplate`, `UIPanelCloseButton`, the size grabber, the scroll-down arrow, quality colours, coin icons on standalone figures.
**Do** give every control and row a 24-unit target (`U.reach`, LM22, LM30).
**Do** footnote an AHledger figure with † and its table age at the page's foot (LM13, LM33).
donts: **Don't** use fluorescent or off-palette accents, gradient or glass shading, or pointed and pill shapes (doctrine).
**Don't** draw flat, borderless web panels, or copy a retail widget where a classic one exists.
**Don't** use red for anything but a loss and the margin rule.
**Don't** ship art or fonts, or name a look inside a view.
**Don't** put a coin icon in a row, column or axis; rows use compact coin letters.
**Don't** put `·` in a title, label or button, or use glyphs outside the plain set.
narrative.notCanonized: Not canonized (craft-floor defects the build carries, not rules): none.
